參考區間下緣位置。展望後市，預期AI 需求帶動高階產品營收占比持續提

進投資評等，目標價700 元(15x FY27E PER)。

轉至高階產品的訂單外溢效應，2. 預估3Q26 稼動率提升至90%。另一方面，漲
價效應浮現將進一步推升毛利率表現，3. AI 伺服器電源規格提升下，除MLCC 外，
鉭質電容、電感及晶片電阻的用量增加。綜上所述，國巨受惠轉單效應、被動元件
產業循環向上、仍有持續漲價機會，考量漲價效應需時間反應，略為下修獲利，以
2027-2028 年平均EPS 預估，給予27 倍本益比(原30 倍)，目標價940 元。

研究部首次給予國巨買進投資建議，主因為：(1)AI伺服器帶動高
階MLCC、鉭質電容、電阻及磁性元件需求成長；另因日韓廠產能往高
階產品移動，亦有望使中高容標準品訂單外溢；(2)B/B Ratio升至2.2，
部分客戶積極洽談LTA提前鎖定未來半年至數年需求，有助提升中長
期訂單能見度；(3)3Q26產能利用率預估升至90%，有望帶動獲利提升。
綜上所述，研究部預估國巨2026/2027年營收分別為1,792/2,273億
元，年增34.8%/26.8%，EPS分別為18.95/27.53元。評價方面，考量
AI需求具結構性成長，供需改善有利ASP及獲利率表現，給予2027年
25倍本益比，目標價688元。

被動元件供給結構性短缺與漲價全面外溢，正推動國巨獲利進入
結構性上修軌道， AI 營收占比由兩年前約 5% 攀升至今約
16%、獲利仍在明確向上的趨勢。惟目前市場動盪，雖EPS 持續
走揚，但估值回歸理性，過去國巨本益比約在10-18 倍，因AI 需
求且股市位階和過去相比明顯提升，仍給予22 倍本益比，以2027

Slightly lift PT to NT$1,030; positive outlook didn’t break: The shares of
many Asian passive names saw +50% corrections in the region after the June
peak. While some investors resetting from extremely bullish pricing
expectations has been a key reason, some negative pricing data points from
Greater China also contributed to the share weakness (but note this applies to
secondary/resell markets, not directly linked to YAGEO and other passive
component makers). We believe our current pricing assumptions of 5-10%
hikes in 2026/10-20% hikes in 2027 (which were previously deemed
conservative by many investors back in June) are still holding up well, as we
believe the long-term thesis of AI creating long-term supply tightness for the
passive industry is still holding up well. We expect more newflows on price
hikes to take place in the industry in the coming weeks. In our view, the
overflow orders/supply chain shift will lift the pricing for YAGEO in the
foreseeable future. So investors should accumulate YAGEO, which is trading
at 16x 2027e EPS, after the likely weakness post results.

We reiterate our Buy rating on Yageo with a new 12m TP of NT$1,280 (from NT$1,490), 
based on the same 26x 2028E PB/ROE (which is in line with the past 10-year peak
multiple), after factoring in our earnings revision.

Yageo’s 2Q26 results beat across scale and margins, with AI revenue mix
rising to 16% and BB ratio climbing to 2.2, underscoring accelerating
forward demand. Mgmt.’s 3Q26E guidance for moderate rev growth and
further margin improvement, alongside commodity/specialty UTR set to
reach 90%+, points to a tightening S/D backdrop, while rising customer
interest in multi-year LTAs across AI, computing, and memory sectors
signals extending demand visibility. We raise our 2026E-28E EPS forecasts
by 11%-13% and lift our ASP growth CAGR assumptions. That said, we
adjust our TP to NT$1,450 (from NT$1,500), applying a 35x average 2027-
28E EPS (vs. 40x prior) to reflect the sector’s ongoing, deleveraging-driven

We raise 2026F/27F/28F EPS from TWD18.7/24.4/29.2 to TWD20.9/33.2/45.0 due to a likely
structural passive component industry shortage and an accelerated capacitor price hike. We think
the current strong AI demand for high-cap MLCC at Murata (6981 JP, Buy) and SEMCO (009150
KS, Buy) is crowding out allocation to non-AI applications, and demand overflows could benefit
Greater China passive makers such as Yageo whose current portfolios are skewed towards the
‘low-end’ and boost their pricing power. Specifically for Yageo, we believe it could leverage a
broader product lineup for bundle sales of tantalum capacitors and R-chips (of which it is the world’s
largest manufacturer, according to Yageo) with MLCCs, at a more favorable pricing to monetize the
structural uptrend. As such, we raise our TP to TWD1,350 (from TWD415), based on 30x 2028F
EPS of TWD45.0 (previously 19x 2H26-1H27F EPS of TWD21.8), with the target multiple at the
higher end of Yageo’s historical trading band (8-40x) to discount the AI-driven business rally and a
more favorable pricing environment. The stock currently trades at 34x 2027F EPS.

利，參考日韓大廠2027年平均本益比交易落在40~50倍區間，目前國巨2027
年預期本益比約33倍，看好評價有望跟進日韓大廠。

惠於產能利用率提升以及漲價合約陸續發酵，帶動獲利優於先前預期，因此上
修2Q26營收至423.6億元，毛利率提升1.2個百分點至39.3%，EPS 4.4元。
AI需求帶動新?波產業循環：展望未來，國巨成長動能將關注在：(1)隨伺服器
功耗提升帶動被動元件用量增加，國巨除了鉭電與電阻等產品將受惠外，在
MLCC方面，由於日韓大廠高階產能稼動率高檔，且高階製程消耗3~5倍產能，
在產能排擠效應下，國巨先前擴充的大發三廠高階產能，有望迎來轉單需求，
(2)因原物料漲幅較大，國巨於4Q25起對鉭電、電阻及電感等產品轉嫁成本，
漲價將陸續發酵；MLCC則因日韓大廠供給吃緊有望?釀漲價，國巨若跟進將
大幅優化產品結構，帶動毛利率提升，(3)目前經銷商庫存約4.8個月，在交期
拉長與低庫存下，有望迎來回補庫存，由於國巨有44%營收來自經銷商，預期
帶動營收成長，基於以上，預估2026年/2027年營收年增29.8%/34.0%至
1,725.5億/2,312.6億元，毛利率達40.1%/46.0%，EPS 18.6元/30.9元。

Yageo is entering a structural upcycle that extends beyond a tactical inv
correction. What began as tightening in high-end MLCCs has expanded into
a broader shortage. Major peers are restricting commodity lines to prioritize
high-capacity AI components, allowing Yageo to capture spillover demand
across its portfolio. Supported by its BB ratio of 1.3, Yageo’s UTRs are
projected to cross the threshold that could trigger further price revisions.
Multi-year demand visibility from next-gen AI platforms decouples this
cycle from past speculative bubbles. Reflecting leverage from volume and
ASP growth, we raise our 2026E-28E EPS by 2-65% and our TP to NT$1,500
from NT$495, based on a re-rated 40x multiple. Reiterate Buy.

台股2日收盤下跌784點，終場以46,164.72點作收，成交量9,184億元，跌幅1.67%；台積電（2330）收盤價2,385元，下跌55元，跌幅2.25%。美伊戰事再度緊張引發投資人再度不安，美股收跌也拉低台股走勢，台積電拉低大盤指數約440點之外，台達電（2308）跌勢也拉低指數下滑約115點，日月光投控（3711）、聯電（2303）、台光電（2383）及鴻海（2317）等股合計拉低至盤指數百點左右。今日成交金額大且走高為：全新（2455）、大立光（3008）、緯創（3231）、雙鴻（3324）、光寶科（2301）、信驊（5274）、光聖（6442）、華邦電（2344）及穎崴（6515）；成交金額大且疲軟者則為：台達電、穩懋（3105）、國巨*（2327）、聯電、臻鼎-KY（4958）、景碩（3189）、日月光投控、京元電子（2449）及南電（8046）。安聯台灣智慧基金經理人陳思銘表示，美國8月零售銷售出現近九個月首度下滑，零售下滑、勞動市場走弱、油價偏高與長天期公債殖利率居高不下，四項風險同時浮現，雖對部分傳產股有所影響，但無礙台股表現，主因AI供應鏈才是多頭重心，且就經濟部預期8月外銷接單年增率可達60%以上來看，資通訊接單強勁逐以抵銷北美一般消費可能轉弱的影響。陳思銘表示，7月底聯準會以9比3維持利率在3.50%–3.75%，下次FOMC會議為9月15–16日，目前市場預期以維持利率不變為多數，以美國財政部都主動介入美債殖利率升高的議題並採取積極的購債行為來壓抑殖利率，維持利率不變是可能的決策，因此9月的FOMC對市場影響有限。
